fuente.titulo: Pope Leo: Bishops should offer clear teaching - Vatican News

bajada: Pontifical Letter to the bishops of Latin America and the Caribbean · 2026
caption:
“At a time when so many voices claim authority over the consciences of the faithful, it is the bishop’s duty to offer a clear teaching that is patient and rooted in this communion, in order to help his people recognize the voice of the one Shepherd.”

— Pope Leo XIV, Pontifical Letter to the bishops of Latin America and the Caribbean (2026)

Via Vatican News, 19 September 2026
